title: POMPEI
text_en: Steeped in elegance and versatility, Pompei by Gio Ponti captures the playful spirit that is a common thread connecting his most iconic works. It effortlessly becomes a bold conversation piece, a multi-level candelabrum, or a mesmerizing vase at the center of a table.

title: GREEN POINT
text_en: Defined by its elongated, horizontal form, the Greenpoint bench by Vincent Van Duysen is a versatile outdoor companion. Designed for mobility and adaptable use, it encourages fluid arrangements in contemporary outdoor spaces. Its simplicity is paired with thoughtful proportions, allowing it to harmonize seamlessly with a variety of settings.

The 5050 drawer unit by Rodolfo Dordoni transforms the bedroom into a space of refined geometry and tactile elegance. This design balances rigorous structure with customizable variety, where every surface and contour is thoughtfully composed. The collection embodies a contemporary approach to storage and display, combining practicality with aesthetic appeal, creating a bedroom environment that is simultaneously serene, sophisticated, and unmistakably modern.

title: PRIME
text_en: The Prime kitchen is for those who approach cooking with a youthful and dynamic spirit. Crafted for ease of use, Prime’s continuous finger recess gracefully traces the entire length and breadth of the cabinetry, extending elegantly onto the side panels. This thoughtful detail replaces traditional finished sides, offering a nuanced canvas for personalization while inviting intuitive, ergonomic use.

title: LA MANO
text_en: La Mano by Gio Ponti came to life through a playful series of letters exchanged with silversmith Lino Sabbatini, who created the object in response to Ponti’s sketch of a six-fingered hand. What began in jest became one of Ponti’s most cherished creations. Both iconic and unexpected, La Mano embodies his irreverent spirit and unmistakable character.

title: GRADUATE
text_en: The Graduate bookshelf by Jean Nouvel is a striking expression of architectural precision transformed into a singular furniture element. Conceived as a suspended line that seems to defy gravity, this modular bookcase embraces an extraordinary sense of lightness. Its name reflects its ascending composition perfectly aligned with Nouvel’s visionary approach to design.

title: LIVING BOX
text_en: Inspired by monumental architecture, Vincent Van Duysen’s Living Box single unit translates the grandeur of buildings, concert halls, and monumental spaces into a sculptural, domestic object. Designed as a self-standing furniture element, it combines elegance with versatility, offering a refined storage solution for contemporary living spaces. Living Box transforms storage into an architectural statement, balancing practicality with a cinematic presence in the home.

title: PARALLEL
text_en: Parallel by Studio Klass is an internal accessories system developed to extend the organizational potential of the Gliss Master wardrobe through linearity and modular precision.

title: AZUL
text_en: Designed as a natural complement to the Azul bed, the Azul Bench embodies Nicola Gallizia’s elegant vision of craftsmanship and proportion. Its use of refined materials paired with architectural design make it a distinctive element that completes the bedroom environment.

title: LOGOS
text_en: Modularity, functionality, and lightness are what inspired Molteni&C's first fully modular living room wall unit system. Designed by Vincent Van Duysen, Logos offers a fresh approach to how space can be designed, offering endless configurations to suit individual tastes and functional needs. The storage module is fully customizable, offering options such as open compartments, doors, or drawers of varying heights, adding both practicality and aesthetic appeal.

title: CLOSER
text_en: Closer by Vibia X Molteni&C, introduces a new poetic language to the Outdoor Collection, redefining how light inhabits space. Designed by Ichiro Iwasaki to move effortlessly between outdoor and indoor environments, the collection expresses an idea of portable luminosity — illuminating without imposing — capable of shaping atmospheres with softness and intention.

title: D.754.1
text_en: Originally conceived in 1954, Gio Ponti's D.754.1 rug embodies the architect’s distinctive ability to transform everyday objects into timeless works of design. Re-edited today as part of the Molteni&C Heritage Collection, the piece captures the spirit of mid-century Italian creativity. Its bold yet refined presence pays tribute to Ponti’s vision of design as both functional and poetic, enriching interiors with a sense of history and timelessness.

title: CAVALLO
text_en: Delicately sculpted with origami-like precision, Cavallo by Gio Ponti demonstrates the expressive power of a single fold that is transformed into a meaningful form. Ponti often drew inspiration from the animal kingdom and was fascinated with the uniqueness of nature and the ability of each animal to affect the space around it.

title: RATIO
text_en: The Ratio kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen is defined by a precise architectural language, with empty volumes and solid elements united in careful balanced. Its defining 13 mm ultra-thin door and integrated handle profiles contribute to a composition that expresses clarity, elegance, and structural coherence.

A contemporary reinterpretation of a timeless storage classic, the 909 modular drawer unit by Luca Meda balances rational design with a subtle nod to tradition. Conceived as an adaptable system, its elements can stand alone or combine to form a more generous storage solution.

title: 505 UP SIDEBOARD
text_en: The 505 Up Sideboard by Nicola Gallizia is a refined evolution of the iconic 505 system, thoughtfully reimagined to meet the nuanced demands of contemporary living. Balancing simplicity with versatility, this sideboard offers endless possibilities for personalization through its diverse front panel combinations.

title: HI-LINE 6
text_en: The Hi-Line 6 by Ferruccio Laviani transforms the kitchen into an architectural living space bringing geometry, precision, and warmth together in perfect harmony. Hi-Line 6 is an enduring example of how design excellence transforms the everyday into the extraordinary.

title: BUCCHERO
text_en: Gio Ponti’s Bucchero presents an elegant reimagining of Etruscan tradition, weaving ancient artistry into the fabric of modern interiors. Reflecting on the past to gain a deeper understanding of its relevance in the present is a common thread throughout Ponti’s work. In collaboration with Buccheri Antonio Rossi, this piece breathes new life into a time-honored craft, resulting in a striking sculptural form.

title: TEOREMA
text_en: The Teorema drawer unit by Ron Gilad embodies the poetic dialogue between solid and void, transforming storage into sculptural architecture. Designed as a conceptual counterpoint to Gilad’s Grado° collection, Teorema explores the idea of containment as an inspired form, where stacked drawers and open compartments create a faceted surface that engages the eye from every angle.

title: OUT
text_en: Out by Vibia X Molteni&C introduces a refined and understated approach to outdoor lighting, reshaping the relationship between object, illumination, and the surrounding environment. Conceived by Victor Carrasco to cast a downward, gently diffused light, it generates subtle gradients across surfaces, bringing depth and texture to terraces, gardens, and open‑air seating areas.

title: VVD
text_en: VVD, a signature kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen, embodies a refined balance between functional precision and understated elegance. Known for its refined details, VVD features enhancements that deepen its sculptural presence while maintaining its timeless, contemporary character. Each element is carefully conceived to celebrate both craftsmanship and the tactility of its materials.

title: SINCRO
text_en: A pinnacle of innovation, the Sincro sliding doors by Studio Klass are a testament to Molteni&C's technical expertise and commitment to excellence. Utilizing both mechanical precision and minimalist design, the Sincro doors integrate beautifully into residential and professional environments, blurring the line between contemporary living and working spaces.

title: KITCHEN BOX
text_en: The Kitchen Box, designed by Vincent Van Duysen, transforms functional storage into an expression of contemporary architecture. With its refined volumes and thoughtful proportions, this versatile element integrates seamlessly across Indada, Prime, Hi-Line6, Hi-Line6 Frame Door, and VVD kitchen systems. It elevates everyday utility with elegance and enriches the spatial rhythm of any contemporary kitchen composition.

title: D.357.1 D.357.2
text_en: The D.357.1 D.357.2 bookcase exemplifies Gio Ponti’s visionary design signature. Originally imagined in 1956-1957 for his private home in Via Dezza, Milan, the bookcase reflects a timeless blend of elegance and practicality. Reissued from his original drawings, the bookcase captures Ponti’s dedication to innovative architectural design and the cultural sophistication that defines the Molteni&C Heritage Collection .

title: HECTOR NIGHT
text_en: Hector Night represents Vincent Van Duysen’s extension of the versatile Hector system into the realm of contemporary bedroom design. Rooted in the expressive, modular character of the original bookcase design, this collection transforms the bedroom area into a flexible, elegant environment. Hector Night allows compositions to be tailored freely, creating spaces that are both visually light and deeply practical.

title: BEAUTÉ
text_en: Rodolfo Dordoni’s Beauté vanity transforms the everyday ritual of preparation into a moment of quiet elegance. Conceived to complement the Blend wardrobe or integrate seamlessly across other settings, Beauté offers a refined sanctuary within the bedroom, where personal items are thoughtfully concealed yet always at hand.

title: TIVALÌ 2.0 BY YABU PUSHELBERG
text_en: Tivalì, originally conceived by Dante Bonuccelli as a visionary built-in kitchen, is reinterpreted by Yabu Pushelberg to unite technology and design with understated elegance. The project celebrates the concept of “Everything in a Small Space,” transforming compact interiors into highly functional environments without compromising on style or comfort. Tivalì embodies a thoughtful balance between practicality and refinement, offering a sophisticated solution for contemporary living.

The 7070 drawer unit by Rodolfo Dordoni reimagines the bedroom as a space of calm elegance and thoughtful functionality. Drawing from Molteni&C’s long-standing tradition of innovative bedroom solutions, the collection blends modern design with practical storage, offering a harmonious setting for rest and relaxation. Each element is conceived with meticulous attention to proportions, materials, and finishes, resulting in a refined bedroom system that is both contemporary and timeless.

title: OPERATING COLUMN 2.0
text_en: The Operating Column 2.0 is a refined evolution of an iconic design, seamlessly blending innovation and elegance. Crafted to harmonize effortlessly across all collections, this column offers thoughtful detail and exceptional versatility.

title: HEDERA
text_en: The Hedera outdoor rug by Vincent Van Duysen bring warmth and texture to outdoor living, celebrating natural Mediterranean tones and artisanal craftsmanship. Designed to harmonize with contemporary terraces, patios, and gardens, this rug design offers an understated elegance that complements the brand’s outdoor collections. Its organic patterns and textural weaves create a sense of rhythm and calm, enhancing the sensory experience of any al fresco environment.

title: ATELIER COLUMN
text_en: The Atelier column by Vincent Van Duysen marries functional sophistication with a bespoke approach to kitchen design. These versatile vertical units serve as both practical storage solutions and aesthetic statements, offering customizable niches that showcase selected objects. Each column reflects Van Duysen’s focus on simplicity, using clean lines and balanced materials to shape the modern kitchen.

title: PANTALICA
text_en: The Pantalica rug by Elisa Ossino embellishes the outdoor space with an artistic touch. Drawing inspiration from ancient Mediterranean cultures and landscapes, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

title: PASS-WORD EVOLUTION GRID-UP WALL UNIT
text_en: The Pass-Word Evolution Grid-Up Wall Unit by Vincent Van Duysen brings a contemporary architectural sensibility to the home, offering a versatile canvas for display and storage. As part of the Password Evolution system, this wall unit transforms the way interiors can be organized while maintaining a light, elegant visual effect. Its design invites both order and fluidity, creating spaces that are functional yet distinctly refined.

title: HECTOR
text_en: The Hector system by Vincent Van Duysen brings a refined vision to upright modular bookcases, blending modernist inspiration with domestic elegance. Hector offers a modular system that is as visually light as it is functional, capable of creating compositions of any length or height. Its thoughtful design transforms the bookcase from a purely utilitarian element into a centerpiece of contemporary interiors.

title: GLISS MASTER MODULAR ISLAND
text_en: The Gliss Master Modular Island by Vincent Van Duysen is designed to seamlessly adapt to the needs of any walk-in closet space. Retaining the signature modules and internal compartments of the Gliss Master system, it optimizes organization while maintaining a harmonious aesthetic with wardrobe finishes. The structure is available in wood, melamine, or matte lacquer, allowing for a refined and cohesive look.

title: TIVALÌ 2.0
text_en: Tivalì by Dante Bonuccelli offers a blend of concealment and revelation, transforming the kitchen into a stage where design and function combine. Originally conceived as a complete kitchen hidden within a linear space, Tivalì 2.0 introduces refined details and enhanced ergonomics while preserving its striking design.

title: INDADA
text_en: The INDada kitchen by Nicola Gallizia is an exercise in refinement through subtraction. By stripping away excess, the design achieves effortless clarity and efficient use of space. Embodying a sophisticated modern character, INDada introduces finishes and materials that reflect Molteni&C’s highest standards of contemporary living.

title: ARIAL
text_en: The Arial boiserie and door system by Studio Klass is inspired by the iconic Arial typeface, known for its clean lines and effortless readability. The system seamlessly blends into any living space, serving as a versatile backdrop for everyday life. From its distinctive decorative panels to its versatile door configurations, Arial pushes the boundaries of the traditional boiserie and offers bespoke solutions tailored to each space's unique contours.

title: PHYSIS
text_en: The Physis kitchen brings Vincent Van Duysen’s organic sensibility to the heart of the home with a soft, contemporary architectural language. Conceived as a coherent system, Physis is defined by rounded corners and fluid transitions that lend the composition a welcoming, tactile appeal.

title: ADRIEN
text_en: Conceived as a series of storage units that celebrate both lightness and clarity, the Adrien single unit by Vincent Van Duysen transforms everyday displays into a subtle act of curation. With a focus on pure geometry and meticulous craftsmanship, Adrien invites the viewer to experience objects as sculptural elements, framed by glass, aluminum, and carefully considered lighting.

title: BOTTIGLIE
text_en: Embodying rich imagination, Bottiglie by Gio Ponti is a set of three bottle-shaped sculptures that form a small family of decorative objects. Ponti conceived the home as a stage, where objects create a lively domestic scene. These pieces, taking on their own personality, create their own unique scene allowing the materials to take center-stage as they age and develop character over time.

title: ARCHITETTURA
text_en: Transcending the dichotomy between architecture and design, Architettura tray by Gio Ponti reveals the two disciplines as complementary and inseparable forces. Inspired by architectural principles, its hexagonal shape recalls a form that has long been central to Ponti’s architectural explorations. Ponti consistently interpreted his surroundings through an architectural lens, channeling that vision to create beauty in everyday life.

title: COLOMBO
text_en: Taking inspiration from the animal kingdom, Gio Ponti created Colombo, a stylized dove, to serve as a reminder of the beauty and simplicity all around us. Ponti’s playful imagination delivers this unique object infusing interior spaces with life.

title: INTERSECTION
text_en: The Intersection kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen transforms natural stone into an architectural centerpiece. Inspired by the fascination of monolithic forms, this kitchen embodies the elegance of a single material, sculpted with precision to create an object that is at once functional and visually striking.

title: 7TUBI
text_en: Sculptural and striking with a modern aesthetic, 7Tubi by Gio Ponti was designed to mirror architectural principles on a more personal scale. As its name suggests, 7Tubi is composed of 7 metal tubes, uniform in diameter, rhythmically offset to form a unique structure with unlimited appeal.

title: GLISS MASTER ISLAND
text_en: Designed as the heart of the wardrobe, Gliss Master Island by Vincent Van Duysen is a free-standing element that completes the walk-in closet or dressing area with refined practicality. It is a central point of order and beauty, transforming daily rituals into moments of ease and elegance.

title: PASS-WORD EVOLUTION
text_en: The Pass-Word Evolution living system by Dante Bonuccelli has established itself as a living area system designed for contemporary homes thanks to its multiple compositional and functional features, combinations of solid and void volumes that allow extreme designing freedom together with an original expressive character.

title: STRIPE BASE
text_en: Named for its distinctive vertical stripe pattern, the Stripe Base unit by Vincent Van Duysen brings rhythm and subtle texture to the kitchen while providing practical low-level storage. Designed to integrate seamlessly into an island or wall unit from any Molteni&C Dada Engineered kitchen design, it combines refined aesthetics with everyday functionality.

title: HORIZONS
text_en: The Horizons single unit by Dante Bonuccelli reimagines traditional shelving systems, introducing a new way to store and showcase the much-loved objects that define daily life. Designed for the living area, it offers a thoughtful balance of concealment and display, as a refined composition of innovation and purpose.

title: EIDON
text_en: Essential and rigorous, the Eidon mirror by Vincent Van Duysen is defined by a slender architectural frame that outlines the reflective surface, creating a clean composition for the contemporary bathroom.

title: ORTHAL
text_en: The Orthal cabinet system by Vincent Van Duysen is conceived like an architectural drawing with sharp edges and clean geometries that establish a disciplined aesthetic. The modular system offers an array of configuration possibilities, ranging from open elements to closed modules available with glass or wood doors.

title: PALETTE
text_en: The Palette rug by Nicola Gallizia is an exploration of matter and color. Bringing expressive warmth and order to interiors, the rug transforms the floor into a canvas of balance and harmony. Palette is conceived as an element that shapes the atmosphere of the room.

title: DUNA
text_en: Inspired by the shifting rhythms of desert landscapes, Nicola Gallizia’s design for the Duna rug translates the impermanence of sand dunes into a refined textile form. Capturing both movement and stillness, Duna is designed to bring warmth and harmony to contemporary interiors.

title: HEM BY G.T.DESIGN
text_en: The Hem rug by Patricia Urquiola reimagines the rug as a gathering place, a tactile island where people can pause, connect, and let the day’s cares slip away. Born from the enduring collaboration between Molteni&C and Patricia Urquiola, this exclusive rug celebrates the dialogue between contemporary Western design and the timeless precision of Asian craft.

title: DEDALO
text_en: The Dedalo rug by Marta Ferri celebrates the beauty of geometry and subtle color, offering a refined presence that gracefully enriches contemporary living spaces. The design balances rigorous structure with elegant hues, blending seamlessly into everyday life. This piece marks Molteni&C’s first collaboration with Maison Pierre Frey, a name synonymous with craftsmanship and textile heritage.

title: SONORO
text_en: Bearing the unmistakable signature of Nicola Gallizia, the Sonoro rug represents a sophisticated floor covering to enhance spaces dedicated to cherished moments of conviviality and sharing, elevating the ambiance with its timeless allure.

title: SISTEMA 7
text_en: The patented Sistema 7 doors by Vincent Van Duysen transform kitchen doors into dynamic architectural elements. Conceived to expand the expressive potential of the door, the system reflects a vision of space as fluid and interconnected.

title: SGA.BELLO
text_en: Designed by Giulio Castegini and Zoran Jedrejcic, Sga.bello, combines comfort, versatility, and a refined sense of personality. Lightweight and stackable, it adapts effortlessly to different settings, bringing both ease of use and a subtle touch of color that can animate the space without overwhelming it.

title: VVD WALL UNIT
text_en: The VVD Wall Unit by Vincent Van Duysen is a streamlined storage element that can be integrated into any Molteni&C Dada Engineered kitchen. Designed with a 19 mm thick aluminum frame, it features doors in bronze or matte lacquer in an array of colors, as well as in 4mm thick tempered transparent glass in transparent, extra-clear, or smoked finishes.

title: SISTEMA 7 WALL UNIT
text_en: The patented Sistema 7 mechanism by Vincent Van Duysen redefines the versatility of kitchen door systems, transforming them into elegant, functional solutions for contemporary interiors. Dada Engineered with precision, this mechanism accommodates full-height doors, offering a seamless integration or unparalleled performance. Its thoughtful design allows for single or double opening directions, marrying practicality with a refined aesthetic that enhances the flow and rhythm of living spaces.

title: FLAIR WALL UNIT
text_en: The Flair Wall Unit by Molteni&C R&D allows for sleek, transparent storage of dishes and everyday kitchen items. Flair features a 19 mm thick aluminum frame and 4 mm thick tempered transparent or smoked glass doors that open laterally by way of a small handle on the underside. A timeless design available in an array of finishes, the Flair Wall Unit can be integrated into any Molteni&C Dada Engineered Kitchen.

title: BRIGHT WALL UNIT
text_en: The Bright wall unit by Molteni&C R&D offers refined containment and versatility. Its minimalist form blends seamlessly into any Molteni&C Dada Engineered kitchen. The possibility to incorporate integrated LED lighting transforms Bright from a streamlined storage solution into a luminous architectural element that enhances both ambiance and functionality.

title: MERIDIANO
text_en: Meridiano by Vibia X Molteni&C introduces a new dialogue between object, light, and open‑air space, merging materiality and illumination into a single sculptural form. Conceived by Xuclà to enhance terraces, gardens, and outdoor lounges with serenity and subtle lighting, this design redefines how an element of furniture can shape the atmosphere around it.

title: D | FRAME WALL UNIT
text_en: A refined balance of form and function, the D|Frame wall unit embodies a thoughtful approach to contemporary living. Translating modular structure into a composed architectural piece, D|Frame offers generous storage, ease of use, and visual clarity in a single, disciplined design.

title: OPEN BASE UNIT
text_en: The Open Base Unit embodies a seamless union of storage and display, integrating drawers and shelving into a single, versatile element. Designed to inhabit columns, walls, or islands, it reflects an approach to kitchen design that balances functionality, material richness, and visual clarity.

title: WING SYSTEM
text_en: The Wing system elegantly redefines the kitchen and living space with its versatile interplay of backsplashes, shelves, and integrated lighting. Designed as a flexible architectural element, Wing offers both practical function and beauty for kitchen worktops or within other living areas. Its thoughtful design enhances everyday storage creating a refined living experience.

title: HI-LINE 6
text_en: Inspired by the kitchen design of the same name, the Hi‑Line 6 bathroom system is defined by clarity, proportion, and restraint. Its design is built around linear, geometric volumes that bring order to the space while maintaining a sense of calm continuity. A versatile solution, Hi‑Line 6 treats the bathroom as a lived‑in environment, combining functionality with carefully controlled forms.

title: MUSCO
text_en: The Musco rug by Marta Ferri draws inspiration from the beauty of the forest undergrowth, translating its rich textures and earthy hues into elegant geometric patterns. This design reflects a balance between nature and craftsmanship, infusing contemporary outdoor spaces with warmth and tactility.

title: INFRA
text_en: The Infra rug by Vincent Van Duysen is defined by a discreet striped pattern. The stripes emerge through a gentle relief rather than contrast, creating depth through texture instead of color. This variation in height gives the surface a tactile quality and introduces a measured play of light and shadow across the floor.

title: MARIUS
text_en: Marius by Christophe Delcourt is a hand‑woven New Zealand wool rug that uses relief and color to articulate the floor. A soft ivory ground sets a calm base, while raised linear accents introduce structure and depth through touch and shadow.

title: ORIZZONTI
text_en: Designed by Marta Ferri for Molteni&C, the Orizzonti rug is crafted from refined wool, embodying the essence of warmth and depth within contemporary living spaces. Inspired by vast landscapes stretching toward the horizon, its intricate tufted weave plays with varying lengths, creating a tactile surface that enhances both visual and sensory appeal.

title: ROADS
text_en: Designed by Marta Ferri for Molteni&C, the Roads rug is a seamless blend of craftsmanship and contemporary elegance. Inspired by the natural intersection of landscapes and pathways, its checkered weave is punctuated by contrasting stripes, evoking the rhythmic movement of roads crossing vast terrains.

title: VIBRAZIONI
text_en: The Vibrazioni rug by Marta Ferri captures the essence of movement and transformation through an interplay of texture and light. Its name, meaning “vibrations” in Italian, represents well the sensory journey of the rug's surface. Shifting patterns and tactile contrasts come alive, inviting the eye and hand to explore its nuanced surface.

title: STRIPE
text_en: The refined elegance of the Stripe rug by Vincent Van Duysen lies in its harmonious balance between simplicity and subtle decoration. Inspired by a pursuit of understated sophistication, the surfaces combine tactile richness with deliberate compositional restraint that complements contemporary interiors

title: EDGE
text_en: The Edge rug by Nicola Gallizia brings new life to two timeless materials — wool and linen — long treasured in the art of rug making. Reinterpreted through Gallizia's design, the union of the two materials creates a surface that feels soft underfoot yet luminous to the eye.

title: AURA
text_en: The Aura rug by Nicola Gallizia reflects elegance and a refined sense of atmosphere. Handcrafted in the Kathmandu valley of Nepal, this rug takes its name from the subtle energy that transforms a space into a place of harmony and comfort. With its understated beauty, Aura is designed to enrich interiors through softness, light, and texture.

title: TELARO
text_en: The Telaro rug by Marta Ferri is a refined exploration of geometry and texture. Designed to move beyond traditional conventions in rug design, Telaro creates a thoughtful balance between modern living and artisanal heritage.

title: RANDOM BY ALTAI
text_en: Random by Patricia Urquiola draws its inspiration from the enduring charm of antique rugs, capturing the character and individuality of well-loved, time-worn textiles. This design celebrates imperfection as a form of beauty, transforming it into a contemporary statement that balances heritage with modern sensibilities.

title: EONE
text_en: Eone, a luxurious long-pile rug by Nicola Gallizia delivers a sensorial experience like no other. This rug enchants with tactile allure and creates an irresistibly inviting ambiance. With a name that conveys a sense of enduring time and permanence, the minimal and timeless design of this rug resists fleeting trends and fashions, remaining relevant and aesthetically pleasing over time.

title: BREEZE
text_en: The Breeze sofa by Matteo Nunziati is a compact design that embodies effortless elegance, created to enrich both intimate city apartments and grand public interiors with equal grace. As the name suggests, Breeze offers a sense of lightness and ease, reflected in a sculptural silhouette with a subtle presence, making it a versatile choice for modern living. The sofa’s streamlined form is defined by a continuous seat that flows seamlessly beneath a gently curved armrest, inviting relaxation without the need for additional cushions. Its sleek construction is grounded by robust, minimalist feet, offering strength while maintaining an airy profile.

title: CASPER
text_en: The Casper drawer unit by Vincent Van Duysen offers a refined minimalist design approach to creating welcoming bedroom spaces. The collection balances rigorous geometry with subtle texture details to complement contemporary interiors. Comprising versatile bedside tables and drawer units, Casper harmonizes with a variety of bedroom settings.

The 606 drawer unit by Rodolfo Dordoni offers an expression of refined simplicity and versatile design, transforming storage into a subtle architectural element. Its elegance stems from a thoughtful balance of materials and finishes, allowing the unit to complement both classic and contemporary interiors. Designed as a flexible family of storage solutions, 606 invites personalization while maintaining a cohesive appeal within the space.

title: STRIPE WALL UNIT
text_en: The Stripe wall unit by Vincent Van Duysen celebrates the interplay between solid and transparent elements, offering a sense of openness and a precise structure. Every detail incorporates craftsmanship and a harmonious balance between utility and aesthetic clarity, allowing Stripe to integrate seamlessly with any Molteni&C Dada Engineered kitchen.

title: VETRA
text_en: The Vetra island by Studio Klass is intended to act as an autonomous object within the bedroom, defined by lightness and precision. Discreet yet architectural, it is designed to organize and support daily living while maintaining a clear spatial boundary within the wardrobe area.

title: D.357.1 D.357.2
text_en: The D.357.1 D.357.2 bookcase exemplifies Gio Ponti’s visionary design signature. Originally imagined in 1956-1957 for his private home in Via Dezza, Milan, the bookcase reflects a timeless blend of elegance and practicality. Reissued from his original drawings, the bookcase captures Ponti’s dedication to innovative architectural design and the cultural sophistication that defines the Molteni&C Heritage Collection .

title: D.355.1 - D.355.2
text_en: Gio Ponti’s enduring passion for redefining everyday objects finds new expression in the D.355.1-D.355.2 hanging bookcase. This refined piece, reimagined for his own Via Dezza residence in Milan (1956-1957), captures Ponti’s timeless ability to blend functional elegance with unparalleled craftsmanship. Its hand-painted finish invites a curated display of books and treasures.

title: D.950.1
text_en: Rooted in Gio Ponti’s refined vision of harmonious interiors, the D.950.1 mirror frames embody a timeless elegance that quietly enhances any space. Designed in 1950 and displayed also at the Ponti’s home on via Dezza in Milan, the frames, offered in various sizes, reflect Ponti’s ability to create pieces that feel both purposeful and graceful within the contemporary home.

title: BED LINEN
text_en: The Molteni&C bed linen collection is made from the most prized natural materials: 100% Egyptian cotton, prized for its luminous white, softness, and breathability, and linen from Normandy, whose yarns are among the finest in the world for strength, brightness, and purity.

title: BLANKETS
text_en: Softness, warmth, and refined materials for every season bring an elegant finish to the living space or bedroom.

title: GLISS MASTER - SISTEMA 7
text_en: The Sistema 7 door introduces a new dimension of elegance and functionality to the Gliss Master wardrobe system. Designed by Vincent Van Duysen to transform both bedrooms and walk-in spaces, this door combines innovative engineering with understated sophistication. Its ingenious opening mechanism allows for a seamless interaction between storage, space, and user experience while maintaining the wardrobe’s refined, contemporary allure.

title: PALMA
text_en: Inspired by the beauty of nature, the Palma rug by Nicola Gallizia translates the sensation of walking barefoot on sand into a refined textile design. Its subtle sheen recalls the natural luster of silk, infusing interiors with understated radiance.

title: 505 UP SYSTEM
text_en: The 505 UP living system by Nicola Gallizia embodies the spirit of refined modular living, ever evolving to embrace the dynamic demands of contemporary interiors. Inspired by architecture, it shapes spaces with a sculptural presence that captures the geometry and rhythm of urban landscapes. A variety of materials and compositional elements enrich its versatility, inviting personalized expression and storage capabilities in living areas and beyond.

title: FRAMIS
text_en: Framis by Vincent Van Duysen is a bathroom system defined by structural continuity and precision of detail. Its identity is shaped by a profiled framework that integrates the doors directly into the vanity, creating a sequence of joints that articulate the composition. The front elevation remains linear and controlled, while the lateral detailing introduces depth and visual interest.

title: RATIO
text_en: Ratio by Vincent Van Duysen introduces a clear architectural order to the bathroom, inspired by structure, proportion, and graphic precision of the original kitchen design. The system is organized around a metal framework that acts as its structural core, with slender grids shaping the composition and establishing a rigorous, geometric rhythm across the collection.

title: ERO
text_en: The Ero bathtub by Vincent Van Duysen is defined by material refinement and a soft, continuous silhouette. Conceived as a single sculptural volume, it is carved in the same stone inside and out, its smooth surface and gently rounded form revealing the material in its purest expression, enhanced by the subtle interplay of light and water. Named after the Greek érōs, meaning desire, Ero explores the beauty of materials and a subtle, sensual form.

title: CARD
text_en: The Card bookcase by Michael Anastassiades embodies the needs of modern living while maintaining a high level of technological innovation. The bookcase combines essential functionality with a contemporary configuration, reflecting Anastassiades' purist and recognizable design ethos. Characterized by a precise graphic identity, the Card bookcase seamlessly integrates Anastassiades' distinctive stylistic approach with the rest of the Collection.

title: GLOVE-UP
text_en: The Glove-Up chair by Patricia Urquiola reinterprets the art of seating through a seamless interplay of line, form, and lightness. The design balances sculptural presence with comfort, translating a rigorous design vision into a chair that is at once visually light and inviting, suitable for contemporary and classic interiors alike.

title: TIBEAU
text_en: The Tibeau bench by GamFratesi is a natural extension of the Tibeau bed, reinforcing its sculptural presence while adding functionality and versatility to the sleeping space. Designed with the same commitment to craftsmanship and material integrity, the bench embodies a dialogue between strength and softness, form and function.

title: ALDGATE
text_en: The Aldgate bench by Rodolfo Dordoni extends the serene elegance of the Aldgate Bed into a refined seating element. Designed as an autonomous piece, it exudes quiet sophistication while harmonizing with the bedroom environment. Soft, fluid lines and understated detailing capture the same sense of calm and comfort as its companion bed, making the bench a functional addition to contemporary interiors.

title: PIVOT COLUMN
text_en: The Pivot Columns offer a fusion of thoughtful design and everyday functionality, crafted to enrich the modern kitchen. Defined by their elegant doors that open to a generous 175°, these columns reflect Molteni&C’s dedication to quality living through design innovation.

title: FULL HEIGHT COLUMNS
text_en: The Full Height Columns exemplify contemporary design, transforming vertical storage into a refined architectural feature within the kitchen. Responding gracefully to varied spatial needs — whether as classic pantry units or as sleek storage for appliances — the columns offer versatile solutions that elevate everyday kitchen experiences.

title: OPEN COLUMN
text_en: Open Column is a refined solution that balances transparency and solidity, designed to showcase treasured objects while offering versatile storage. Developed with an emphasis on material contrast and clean lines, this piece brings a subtle architectural allure to interiors, reflecting a thoughtful dialogue between open space and enclosure.

title: REVOLVING COLUMN
text_en: The Revolving Column transforms corner storage into a seamless blend of ingenuity and elegance. Conceived to maximize every inch of space, it reveals a practical solution for effortless organization. Its design transforms the pantry into a refined centerpiece of the contemporary kitchen.

title: SISTEMA XY
text_en: Inspired by the precision of Cartesian coordinates, the Sistema XY kitchen system by Francesco Meda redefines order and accessibility. Designed with a clear architectural logic, this modular concept transforms the kitchen into a space of intuitive beauty where every element serves a practical purpose.

title: HI-LINE 6 FRAME DOOR
text_en: Hi-Line 6 Frame Door redefines modern kitchen design with its clean, linear silhouette enhanced by refined materials and thoughtful details. The unit’s frame elegantly complements an array of quality finishes, while the ergonomically shaped grip at the top of each door invites effortless interaction. This kitchen system embodies contemporary sensibility and everyday practicality.

title: OPEN TECHNICAL COLUMNS
text_en: The Open Technical Columns are free from mechanisms or doors, creating striking niches to organize kitchen essentials. Available in multiple widths and matched in height to all Molteni&C storage columns, these open units provide a convenient top surface for small appliances or tools complete with illuminated wooden drawers and shelves, creating opportunities for personal styling.

title: PALINFRASCA
text_en: The Palinfrasca armchair distills the defining themes of the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection into a singular, intimate form. Its curved, enveloping teak frame and distinctive macro-scale weave evoke a sense of refinement, while its more compact proportions allow the artistry of design to shine with clarity.

title: GLISS MASTER
text_en: The Gliss Master by Vincent Van Duysen redefines the art of organization with a wardrobe system that combines bespoke tailoring, refined materials, and thoughtful design. Conceived to adapt seamlessly to individual needs, it transforms storage into an elegant ritual. Every component, from doors and shelves to accessories and finishes, can be personalized, allowing each Gliss Master to become a unique reflection of its owner’s style.

title: BALTIMORA
text_en: Baltimora is a double-sided island unit designed to be placed in the center of a room. Versatile and eclectic, it can adapt to any location in the bedroom, creating either a unique standalone element or a dynamic dialogue with existing wardrobes or cabinets.

title: ERO
text_en: The Ero sink by Vincent Van Duysen unites material refinement and soft silhouettes. Available in freestanding and countertop versions, each piece is characterized by rounded, continuous lines and a unique visual identity.

title: D.555.1
text_en: Originally designed by Gio Ponti between 1954 and 1955 for his own home in Via Dezza in Milan, the D.555.1 small table is a refined testament to the architect’s enduring design legacy. This piece, that never reached the mass production at Gio Ponti's time, is faithfully reproduced by Molteni&C from original archival drawings.

title: EMILE
text_en: An expression of modular elegance, Emile by Christophe Delcourt is a dynamic sofa system designed to adapt to the evolving needs of contemporary living. Characterized by a sculptural silhouette, Emile features a refined backrest with fluid, shifting heights, creating a harmonious play of proportions. Distinctive graphic marks trace its form, ensuring a striking presence from every perspective.

title: JULIAN
text_en: The Julian modular seating system by Vincent Van Duysen is welcoming, warm and convivial. The contrasting profile defines its rhythm, captures the gaze, guides it along the surface and reveals subtle construction details.

title: EDMOND
text_en: The Edmond sofa by Christophe Delcourt is a modular seating system that works as a flexible structure defined by movement, variation, and comfort. The design is organized around a series of elements that allow for asymmetric compositions and changing depths, encouraging different ways of sitting and using the sofa without prescribing them.

title: AUGUSTO
text_en: If home is the heart of daily life, the Augusto sofa by Vincent Van Duysen is where one finds home. Augusto is a versatile seating system blending timelessness with contemporary flair. Embodying the welcoming spirit of Molteni&C, this sofa offers linear and rounded elements for versatile customization, including chaise lounges and islands to serve as relaxation zones. From compact spaces to spacious living rooms, Augusto offers solutions tailored to diverse needs.

title: TURNER
text_en: Turner by Hannes Wettstein exemplifies the art of transformation, seamlessly shifting between formal elegance and relaxed comfort. Designed as a versatile seating system, it adapts effortlessly to contemporary living spaces. With its understated lines and thoughtful proportions, Turner offers a refined presence that enhances both intimate settings and expansive interiors.

title: CLEO
text_en: The Cleo sofa by Vincent Van Duysen is a modular seating system that harmonizes architectural precision with inviting comfort. Combining rectilinear, angular, and self-standing elements, Cleo adapts to a wide range of living environments, from intimate corners to open-plan arrangements. Its fluid curvilinear shell envelops the seat and back, creating a sanctuary-like form that balances elegance with a sense of warmth and relaxation.

title: PAUL
text_en: The Paul sofa by Vincent Van Duysen reflects the designer’s commitment to expressive rationality, blending comfort with balanced form, reassuring lines and thoughtful detailing. Encompassing linear sofas, angular compositions, chaises longues, and islands, Paul celebrates the understated sophistication of contemporary living, offering versatile seating solutions that harmonize effortlessly within both intimate and expansive interiors.

title: MARTEEN
text_en: The Marteen sofa by Vincent Van Duysen is a modular seating and storage system defined by balance, flexibility, and sculptural presence. Its instinctive design alternates solids and voids creating a dynamic rhythm and allowing for an infinite range of compositions, from single poufs to classic two-seaters, or expansive 360° islands. Marteen transforms the way communal spaces are inhabited and shaped, offering a continuity of comfort, functionality, and architectural elegance.

title: OCTAVE
text_en: Designed by Vincent Van Duysen, Octave is a modular sofa system characterized by rigorous shapes - a subtle study of proportions, creating a graphic interplay of geometric volumes. It’s inspired by wide skyscraper windows that offer breathtaking views over cosmopolitan megacities while comfortably seated on inviting sofas.

title: GREGOR
text_en: Vincent Van Duysen’s Gregor modular sofa system embodies a refined approach to contemporary living. Designed for spaces devoted to conversation, reading, and entertainment, Gregor offers a modular architecture that balances low, inviting proportions with precise detailing. The design is an ode to lightness, a harmonious, contemporary language created by the contrast of soft, comfortable and generous cushions and the strong, precise and linear metal basement.

title: SURF
text_en: The Surf sofa by Yabu Pushelberg explores the nature of organic forms beyond the traditional, rendering a seating solution rich in unexpected details. Defined by fluid, undulating shapes inspired by waves, the sofa's artfully designed rectilinear, chaise longue, corner and terminal elements — partially devoid of backrests — give rise to multiple compositions. This fluid sofa is ideal for residential or hospitality projects, such as hotels or office spaces.

title: ALBERT
text_en: The Albert sofa by Vincent Van Duysen is defined by clean, confident lines, transforming modern living spaces with a modular approach blending ergonomic comfort with refined craftsmanship. Featuring large modules in two depths and in multiple lengths, Albert adapts seamlessly to both intimate and expansive interiors.

title: REVERSI '14
text_en: Reversi ’14 by Studio Hannes Wettstein is a modular sofa designed to respond to contemporary living with elegance and adaptability. An innovative backrest mechanism enables adjustable seating depth, adapting effortlessly to a range of postures, from upright focus to leisurely lounging. Named to evoke the idea of reversibility and transformation, Reversi ’14 allows the user to personalize a configuration to their evolving needs.

title: D.157.6 - DUE FOGLIE
text_en: The D.157.6 Due Foglie sofa by Gio Ponti was first created in 1957 for Ponti’s stunning design for Villa Planchart in Caracas, commissioned by Anala and Armando Planchart, ardent admirers of Ponti’s diverse talents. The sofa, one of the villa's iconic features, is part of the Heritage Collection thanks to the collaboration with the Gio Ponti Archives.

title: LUCIO
text_en: Contemporary living is at the heart of the Lucio sofa design by Vincent Van Duysen. This beautifully constructed sofa embodies a harmonious blend of functionality and character, united by an artistic vision that elevates any space. Available in two sofa configurations, Lucio offers versatility and customization to any living space.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: Rodolfo Dordoni’s Chelsea sofa brings the refined comfort of the dining collection into the living area, transforming seating into a space for relaxation, reflection, and elegance. Inspired by the timeless bergère, Chelsea blends contemporary sensibilities with classic forms, creating a sofa that is both inviting and sculptural.

title: SKIN
text_en: The result of many years of collaboration between Jean Nouvel and Molteni&C, the SKiN sofa is constructed of a self supporting hide leather cover with a special pattern — a texture crossed by light and suspended in space. Leather without body reshapes itself over time so that innovation and memory hold the same form. The SKiN sofa is the recipient of the 2008 Red Dot Best of the Best Award, 2008, the 2008 ELLE DECOR Design Award, and appeared in the 2008 ADI Index.

title: LIDO
text_en: The Lido sofa by Hannes Wettstein balances contemporary elegance and an inviting softness thanks to its disciplined, architectural lines of Nordic precision. This duality makes the pieces equally suited to formal spaces and relaxed living environments, embodying an effortless sophistication.

title: CORSETTO
text_en: The Corsetto armchair by Cristián Mohaded is defined by containment and softness, shaped through the designer's distinctive approach to form and material. The piece draws on the tension between structure and comfort, using leather and fabric as elements that actively shape the design. Every detail contributes to a precise, tactile experience rooted in control, proportion, and restraint.

title: BOSCO
text_en: Bosco by Naoto Fukasawa is an armchair that invites the body to let go. Inspired by the gentle hills of Tuscany, its soft silhouette and subtly divided contours echo the rhythms of the landscapes. Its form is defined by generous volumes that support the body naturally, allowing the sitter to settle into the chair's embrace. The design favors continuity, shaping a compact silhouette that feels stable, protective, and calm within the space.

title: D.154.2
text_en: Gio Ponti’s D.154.2 armchair captures the architect’s luminous spirit and masterful approach to form with its embracing, sinuous silhouette. The iconic armchair was born from a deeply personal project, the Villa Planchart in Caracas (1953-1957) - the private residence of art collectors Anala and Armando Planchart, which they commissioned Gio Ponti to design from top to bottom as both the architect and the interior designer.

title: MONK
text_en: A history-making 1973 design by Afra and Tobia Scarpa for Molteni&C, Monk reemerges with this exclusive re-edition, part of the Heritage Collection. Available both as a versatile chair for the dining area and an armchair for the living room or bedroom, Monk is defined by its pared-down aesthetic that highlights the expressive qualities of leather against solid wood.

title: ARMAND
text_en: A design by Christophe Delcourt, the Armand armchair defined by a precise balance between fine upholstery, a solid structure, and expert craftsmanship. Its form is built around a thin metal shell that wraps the backrest and extends to embrace the chair as a whole, giving the piece a contained profile with a clear construction.

title: LEONARD
text_en: Leonard by Christophe Delcourt is an armchair defined by clarity of form and versatility of use. Its design is organized around a double‑shell structure that combines containment and comfort, allowing the chair to function naturally across different settings, from workspaces to more relaxed domestic environments.

title: LIA
text_en: The Lia armchair by GamFratesi is a masterful expression of lightness and refined craftsmanship. Designed with an interplay of structure and suspension, Lia embodies a harmonious balance of materials, where the warmth of oak meets the strength of metal.

title: ROUND D.154.5
text_en: Gio Ponti’s Round D.154.5 armchair is a visionary icon that captures the spirit of mid-century innovation and modernity. With its groundbreaking shape and pioneering use of materials, this design, originally created in 1954, marked a pivotal moment in Ponti’s career, embracing new possibilities born from the era’s optimism and technological advances. Now reissued by Molteni&C, iconic masterpiece is made new with remarkable fidelity.

title: EUGÈNE
text_en: The Eugène armchair by Christophe Delcourt is the perfect embodiment of ergonomic design and refined elegance, created to offer an enveloping, luxurious seating experience. With its sinuous backrest and fluid lines, Eugène offers exceptional comfort while maintaining a striking, sculptural presence.

title: LINEA
text_en: The Linea armchair represents the fluid continuity of the Molteni&C Collection. With airy shapes and essential lines, it invites an exploration of a design concept that is open and projected towards infinity. Designed with compact yet inviting proportions, it offers both stylistic continuity and exceptional versatility.

title: D.151.4
text_en: Nautical furnishings had long been a source of fascination for Gio Ponti when he was commissioned to design an armchair for four ocean liners and two cruises between 1949–1951: the Conte Grande, the Africa, the Oceania, the Conte Biancamano, the Andrea Doria and the Giulio Cesare. His creation, D.151.4, appeared on each, with slight variations in design to match the ship’s interior. This piece captures the spirit of refined travel, blending timeless style with thoughtful ergonomics.

title: ELAIN
text_en: The Elain chair by Vincent Van Duysen is a compact yet inviting armchair that embodies warmth and simplicity. Designed with a curvaceous form, this design balances comfort with effortless charm. Whether placed as an intimate accent or paired with other Van Duysen seating elements, Elain transforms any setting with understated elegance.

title: CONTINUUM D.163.7
text_en: Designed by Gio Ponti in 1963, Continuum draws inspiration from bergères created in the early 1950s for hotels and cruise ships. Crafted entirely in Italy, the armchair utilizes first-class materials from the rattan family: manao and malacca sourced from the equatorial forests of Indonesia. Each piece demands over 200 hours of meticulous craftsmanship.

title: CINNAMON
text_en: The Cinnamon armchair by the Japanese designer Naoto Fukasawa is a masterpiece of furniture design that seamlessly blends form, function, and comfort. With an air of warmth, the enveloping shape evokes a deep sense comfort and relaxation.

title: D.156.3
text_en: Gio Ponti’s design for D.156.3 captures the essence of Italian modernism. Created in 1956 for the American company Altamira, founded by the nephew of De Cuevas, this piece was proudly showcased in New York alongside works by celebrated designers such as Ico Parisi and Franco Albini, reflecting the vibrant dialogue between Italian craftsmanship and international modernity at the 10th Milan Triennale.

title: D.153.1
text_en: An emblem of Italian design heritage, the D.153.1 armchair carries the unmistakable touch of Gio Ponti. Originally created in 1953 for his private residence on Via Dezza in Milan and reintroduced by Molteni&C from Ponti’s own archival drawings, the piece captures the designer’s modernist spirit, inviting a dialogue between history and contemporary living.

title: LUCIO
text_en: The Lucio armchair by creative director Vincent Van Duysen embodies the desire for elegance and relaxation in modern settings. This carefully constructed accent piece represents the duality of aesthetic fulfillment and practical use, a harmonic melding of fluidity and femininity.

title: KENSINGTON
text_en: With Kensington, Rodolfo Dordoni reinterprets the tradition of the classic Bergère through the lens of contemporary Italian design. Conceived for relaxation or conversation, the design combines sculptural lines with refined comfort. Whether in its high or low version, Kensington embodies a balance of elegance and intimacy, designed to enrich both private homes and hospitality spaces.

title: AUGUSTO
text_en: The Augusto armchair by Vincent Van Duysen captures the enduring essence of the Augusto series with one bold accent piece. This design continues the evolution of sophisticated comfort, blending a classic silhouette with a contemporary aesthetic.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: The Chelsea armchair by Rodolfo Dordoni offers a sanctuary of comfort for conversation and relaxation within contemporary living spaces. Designed to create intimate corners in expansive rooms, Chelsea transforms seating into a refined experience inviting both quiet reflection and social connection.

title: GILLIS
text_en: The Gillis armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is a compact, low design that embodies modernist elegance with practical versatility. Originally conceived for hospitality spaces such as hotel lobbies, lounges, and bars, it also finds a graceful home in residential setting complementing sofas or as an intimate reading chair.

title: DODA - DODA LOW
text_en: The Doda armchair by Ferruccio Laviani reinterprets the timeless bergère with a contemporary sensibility, blending classic elegance with modern comfort. Its form is both welcoming and architectural, defined by an interplay of straight and curved lines.

title: WALTER
text_en: Rooted in the Nordic tradition of fine woodworking, the Walter armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is a compact design that distills warmth and simplicity into a contemporary form.

title: MARGOU
text_en: The Margou armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is a sculptural design that exemplifies a pursuit of aesthetic purity, transforming a familiar seating style into a striking modern furniture design. Its sensuous contours and careful proportions create a distinctive silhouette, while the dialogue between structure and upholstery celebrates a refined craftsmanship.

title: TUSCANY
text_en: The Tuscany chaise longue by Naoto Fukasawa interprets the iconic vistas of the Italian landscape through the lens of the designer's own aesthetic, merging stylistic cues in a way that captures the finest of both worlds — the Italian and the Japanese.

title: PICCADILLY
text_en: The Piccadilly armchair by Rodolfo Dordoni reinterprets the art of seating with a focus on comfort and sculptural elegance. Designed as a study of intersecting surfaces shaping new forms, Piccadilly creates enveloping shapes that invite relaxation. Each armchair is conceived to harmonize with contemporary living, offering a balance of refined presence and everyday usability.

title: PAULA
text_en: The Paula armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is an innovative design that creates a sense of movement and lightness. The key to Paula’s timelessness is its carefully considered proportions. With a cantilevered frame and suspended cushions, the armchair is designed to create a synthesis between the soft and inviting seat and the solid and robust frame.

title: GLOVE-UP
text_en: The Glove-Up armchair by Patricia Urquiola embodies a graceful evolution of sculptural design, with sinuous, molded lines that connect the backrest to the delicately poised legs. Its form conveys a sense of effortless lightness, transforming a simple chair into an object of elegance.

title: D.552.2
text_en: The D.552.2 small table captures Gio Ponti’s architectural genius through its elegant balance of materials and proportions. Designed originally in 1952, this piece embodies Ponti's architectural fantasy, a virtuoso display of spans, an acrobatic feat of proportions, a criss-cross of joints.

title: ETER
text_en: The Eter coffee table by Vincent Van Duysen combines continuity and suspension in a composition of two distinct planes held in elegant balance. Available in three sizes, the table is designed to work as a single piece or in grouped arrangements, adapting easily to different spatial contexts and uses.

title: JEANNE
text_en: The Jeanne coffee table by Christophe Delcourt is designed as a system of connections, where base and tops are resolved as interdependent elements rather than separate parts. The piece is organized around a central fulcrum structure that supports and joins two overlapping planes, giving the table a clear architectural order and a strong sense of balance.

title: LOUISA
text_en: Louisa by Vincent Van Duysen is a collection of round and oval coffee tables that explore the dialogue between material and form. By pairing wood and cement, Van Duysen achieves a refined contrast, offering a contemporary centerpiece that balances lightness and presence. Inspired by principles of modern design, Louisa transforms everyday surfaces into sculptural elements that enrich the living space.

title: ASTER
text_en: The Aster coffee table by Vincent Van Duysen is the ultimate expression of compositional rationality and craftsmanship. A unique object made entirely by hand, it is a contemporary work of art that combines aesthetics and functionality. Each table has a slightly different connotation, testifying to its handcrafted nature.

title: FLEUR
text_en: The Fleur coffee table by Christophe Delcourt embodies an exquisite fusion of craftsmanship and understated elegance. Featuring a rounded textured glass top, this delicate piece combines transparency and soft, organic lines, making it both sophisticated and versatile.

title: MAYLIS
text_en: A study in contrast and refinement, Maylis is a sculptural coffee table that balances geometric precision with organic richness. Designed by Christophe Delcourt, its hexagonal-multiform top is available in marble, tempered glass, and glossy lacquered finishes, each offering a distinctive aesthetic to the table. This bold yet fluid design integrates seamlessly with Delcourt’s wider collection, bringing a sense of movement and versatility to contemporary interiors.

title: ODILE
text_en: The Odile coffee table by Christophe Delcourt combines striking design with versatile functionality, making it an ideal companion for contemporary living spaces. With its graphic lines and dynamic form, this table seamlessly integrates into the Emile sofa composition, while also standing out as a standalone piece.

title: FONTE
text_en: Refined craftsmanship meets innovation with Fonte coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen, featuring three table designs for three different uses. The coffee table, lounge table and night table each rest on sturdy oak legs to support the tabletop, available in an array of finishes. The subdued color hues of each tabletop harmonize with the base to create a contemporary interplay of solidity and fluidity.

title: DOMINO NEXT
text_en: In the Domino Next collection, Nicola Gallizia explores the elegance of essential form and the expressive power of materials. Conceived as a family of versatile pieces, Domino Next offers small tables and poufs that can stand alone or fit seamlessly together. The design won the Wallpaper* Design Award 2017.

title: LÈA
text_en: A pure expression of sculptural design, Lèa by Christophe Delcourt is a statement piece that balances boldness and refinement. Its monolithic form, defined by clean geometric lines, echoes the architectural language of the Odile coffee table collection, characterized by a rectangular base and by an irregular exagonal top.

title: ALISEE
text_en: With the Alisee coffee table, designer Matteo Nunziati gives form to a vision of expressive rationality — an approach where clarity of design becomes a language of elegance. The piece reflects the architect’s ability to balance precision with warmth, offering furniture that feels both essential and deeply human. In Alisee, restraint is not minimalism but refinement, the kind that allows spaces to breathe while elevating their atmosphere.

title: 45°/TAVOLINO
text_en: 45°/Tavolino by Ron Gilad highlights the designer's fascination with geometry and the subtle poetry of simple forms. Each table embodies an “open box” concept, where contours define space without overwhelming it, creating a sense of lightness and transparency. 45°/Tavolino harmonizes with a variety of interiors, as the collection blends sculptural presence with practical versatility.

title: MARTEEN
text_en: Marteen coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen extend the sculptural language of the Marteen seating system. Defined by generous surfaces and overlapping tops, they create a dialogue between form, material, and volume. Each table can function independently or be combined with others to create layered compositions, offering a dynamic and contemporary expression of individual style.

title: CLEO
text_en: The Cleo coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen are small domestic sculptures that take inspiration from the geometric elegance of an oval. These small tables complement the modular Cleo sofa system offering elevated sophistication in a functional piece.

title: VICINO TABLE
text_en: The Vicino table by Foster + Partners blends advanced technology with an elegant, architectural aesthetic. Designed with the goal of adding movement and adaptability to living spaces, the Vicino transforms to meet evolving needs. Its seamless functionality invites interaction, while its refined materials and distinctive silhouette make it a stand-alone statement piece.

title: REGENT
text_en: The Regent coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen are the indoor interpretation of a design originally created for Molteni&C Outdoor. The tables’ essential fluidity demonstrates that, aesthetically, these forms can live comfortably in any context and can create a natural continuity between the indoors and outdoors.

title: PANNA COTTA
text_en: Inspired by the iconic Italian dessert, Panna Cotta low table by Ron Gilad balances visual lightness with solid structured form. Enriching contemporary interiors from the living room to the bedroom, this table embodies a poetic paradox with its delicate form and impactful allure.

title: ATTICO
text_en: Attico by Nicola Gallizia is a collection of coffee tables that embodies a distinctly architectural spirit. Designed as versatile companions to contemporary living, these tables balance clarity of form with distinctive finishes and materials, offering a new way to define and experience the domestic landscape.

title: HUBERT
text_en: Designed by Vincent Van Duysen to accompany the Gregor sofa, the Hubert set of small tables extends the collection’s refined, contemporary language into functional surfaces. Each table reflects the sofa’s soft, rounded angles, creating a harmonious dialogue between seating and occasional table. Thoughtfully conceived, these tables balance sculptural presence with everyday practicality.

title: PICEA
text_en: The Picea coffee table by Vincent Van Duysen enhances living spaces with its distinctive, visually monolithic look. Crafted entirely in ceramic, Picea boasts gracefully rounded lines and a harmonious design, echoing the natural beauty of the Arctic evergreen spruce tree from which it takes its name.

title: TESO
text_en: The Teso table by Foster + Partners is a sculptural piece that embodies the studio’s mastery of architectural form and material innovation. Defined by an extraordinary silhouette, Teso transforms the traditional concept of a table into a striking centerpiece, where structure itself becomes an object of beauty.

title: WHEN
text_en: Conceived as a striking companion piece, the When coffee table by Rodolfo Dordoni moves fluidly between the living and bedroom areas of the home. Defined by its sculptural simplicity and crafted in solid wood, When is as much an expression of design culture as it is a furnishing accessory.

title: BLEVIO
text_en: Part of the Molteni&C Heritage Collection, Ignazio Gardella’s Blevio table is a celebration of timeless design and architectural rigor. Conceived for Gardella’s own villa on Lake Como in 1930, this table embodies the purity and balance that defined his work. Its refined geometry and sculptural simplicity transcend eras, offering a piece that harmonizes effortlessly with both classic and contemporary interiors.

title: DIAMOND
text_en: Inspired by the delicate precision of origami, Patricia Urquiola’s Diamond table transforms distinctive folds into a sculptural expression of contemporary elegance. The table's finely articulated legs create a sense of lightness, while the geometric harmony of the square or rectangular top grounds the design in balance and sophistication. Diamond was recipient of the Red Dot “Best of the Best” in 2005 and featured in the 2005 ADI Index.

title: LISE
text_en: The Lise table by Christophe Delcourt is a masterpiece of sculptural design, offering a blend of aesthetic elegance and functional beauty. With its organic shape and harmonious proportions, Lise elevates any space, bringing a refined touch to expansive, airy interiors.

title: ARC
text_en: The Arc table by Foster + Partners is a striking fusion of architectural inspiration and innovative material. Inspired by the techno-structures used in modern building construction, Arc translates engineering precision into an elegant contemporary furnishing. With its bold presence and refined simplicity, the table transforms any setting into a harmonious blend of design and structure. The Arc table is the recipient of the Elle Decor Design Award, 2011.

title: MATEO
text_en: Vincent Van Duysen's Mateo table ushers in new possibilities, boasting a distinctive central pedestal characterized by a cylindrical and conical shape, vertically grooved at its base. Enriched with fresh compositional options and new sizes (300, 350 and 400 cm), the table stands atop a gently flaring curved base, ensuring stability while adding an element of surprise.

title: FILIGREE
text_en: The Filigree table by Rodolfo Dordoni embodies the seamless union of technology and elegance, offering a range of fixed-size and extension tables designed for modern living. Created with a focus on refined proportions and intelligent functionality, the collection transforms dining or work environments into spaces of understated sophistication.

title: ASTERIAS
text_en: Inspired by the sculptural form of the Asterias cactus native to the mountainous regions of Mexico, the Asterias table by Patricia Urquiola transforms natural geometry into refined, contemporary design. The table's generous round top and central base mimic the radial symmetry of the cactus, creating a striking yet harmonious presence in any dining or gathering space. Asterias is a bold blend of natural inspiration and meticulous craftsmanship.

title: GATWICK
text_en: Inspired by London’s iconic airport, the Gatwick table by Rodolfo Dordoni captures the essence of connection and gathering. Just as travelers converge from around the world, this table brings people together in the home, creating a shared space for conversation, dining, and conviviality. Its thoughtful proportions and elegant design transform every meal into an occasion.

title: AVA TABLE
text_en: Evolving from the studio’s earlier work on modular metal furniture for UniFor Elements series, Ava reinterprets those principles through timber, creating a visually dynamic piece.

title: LESSLESS
text_en: Originally created for the Fondation Cartier in Paris in 1994, LessLess by Jean Nouvel exemplifies the purity of design reduced to its essential form. This collection of rectangular and square tables expresses an architectural clarity, bringing purpose to every detail. Defined by its light lines and striking minimalism, LessLess reveals how simplicity and precision offer an expression of elegance.

title: D.859.1
text_en: Gio Ponti’s D.859.1 table, designed in 1959 for the auditorium of the Time&Life Building in New York, provides a distinctive balance of grandeur and simplicity designed to host intimate gatherings while making a striking architectural statement. Generous in length, exceeding 3.6 meters, this table captures a sense of movement, its tapered top and slender legs reminiscent of a sleek aerodynamic form.

title: OLD FORD
text_en: The Old Ford table by renowned Italian designer Rodolfo Dordoni is a pure embodiment of the Molteni&C commitment to aesthetics, functionality, and technical innovation. Composed of a round-edge top with a gentle downward curve to meet four glossy lacquered legs connected by an H-shaped beam, Old Ford brings sculptural elegance to any living or hospitality space.

title: HALF A SQUARE
text_en: The Half a Square table by Michael Anastassiades captures the essence of minimalist sophistication through a dialogue of geometry and exquisite materials. Born in Cyprus and based in London, Anastassiades brings a refined sensibility to this series of rectangular and square tables that feel both modern and timeless.

title: ARIA
text_en: The Aria writing desk by Vincent Van Duysen blends lightness and strength, designed to integrate seamlessly into any living space. With its refined silhouette and meticulous attention to detail, Aria embodies a contemporary aesthetic while offering a highly functional workspace.

title: D.847.1
text_en: Gio Ponti’s D.847.1 desk expresses the essence of refined innovation, blending sculptural elegance with practical design. Its distinctive curved top, inspired by the graceful form of an airplane wing, introduces a sense of lightness and movement, while the subtly rounded drawer front hints at Ponti’s flair for reinterpreting tradition with modernity. This piece, originally designed in 1947, is emblematic of his design legacy.

title: NOTE
text_en: Rooted in Molteni&C’s heritage of masterful woodworking, the Note desk by Matteo Nunziati offers a refined balance between modernity and exquisite craftsmanship. Its design expresses elegance, where thoughtful aesthetic and technical details come together to create a piece that is functional and sculptural, ideal for today’s refined workspaces.

title: SCRIBA
text_en: The Scriba desk by Patricia Urquiola offers clean lines and subtle detailing to create a work surface of understated elegance. The decoratively perforated top support introduces a sense of lightness to any interior.

title: MIDDAY
text_en: The Midday console by GamFratesi translates the constructive logic of the sideboard into a lighter, more compact design. Defined by a reduced depth and a clear structural outline, the piece is built around the same essential composition: a central body supported by two legs, joined through a visible and deliberate connection.

title: PÉNÉLOPE
text_en: The Pénélope console by Christophe Delcourt captivates with its organic lines and sculptural elegance. This striking piece elevates any space, where its refined materials and thoughtful geometry come together in perfect harmony.

title: ATELIA
text_en: The Atelia chair by GamFratesi is conceived around the concepts of care, proportion, and closeness to the body. Its design focuses on the seated experience, supporting without rigidity in a design that is composed without appearing formal. Compact and measured, the chair's silhouette allows it fit naturally into dining and living contexts alike.

title: MONK
text_en: A history-making 1973 design by Afra and Tobia Scarpa for Molteni&C, Monk reemerges in 2025 with this exclusive re-edition, part of the Heritage Collection. Available both as a versatile chair for the dining area and an armchair for the living room or bedroom, Monk is defined by its pared-down aesthetic that highlights the expressive qualities of leather against solid wood.

title: DEVON
text_en: The Devon chair by Rodolfo Dordoni transforms seating into an expression of versatile elegance. Designed to complement any interior, from intimate corners to lively communal spaces, this design balances functional clarity with a subtle refinement for cultivated interiors.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: The Chelsea chair by Rodolfo Dordoni thoughtfully blends contemporary design and timeless tradition, offering a seat that feels both modern and rooted in cultural memory. Inspired by the elegance of classic forms reinterpreted for today, Chelsea offers refined seating, perfect for settings where thoughtful design meets the pleasures of conversation and convivial dining.

title: PORTA VOLTA
text_en: The Porta Volta Chair by Herzog & de Meuron is an immediately striking piece. The design’s defining element comes from the solid wood back which is curved in a U-shape, creating an inviting and enveloping feel. The floating backrest extends further to create armrests. If desired, the backrest can be bisected by a customizable cushion. Three U-frames with a unique curved “finger joint” lend the piece a detailed softness. The four legs and back are angled slightly outwards which provides a stable and comfortable repose.

title: JANET
text_en: The Janet chair by Vincent Van Duysen is a study in refined simplicity and timeless elegance. With clean, delicate lines, the chair embodies the balance between visual lightness and thoughtful ergonomics. Its design seamlessly combines distinctive materials and comfort, offering a versatile companion for a variety of tables.

title: MHC.3 MISS
text_en: The Miss chair by Afra and Tobia Scarpa embodies a delicate balance between historic architecture and innovation. Its fluid, linear form creates a soft rhythm that guides the eye across the chair, while every curve and joint reflects a careful dialogue between craftsmanship and comfort. Originally conceived in 1986, Miss has been reinterpreted by Molteni&C to honor its heritage while remaining strikingly modern.

title: OUTLINE
text_en: The Outline chair by Arik Levy bridges comfort and versatility with a thoughtful, modern design. Featuring an ergonomically contoured fiberglass seat adorned with removable fabric or leather upholstery, Outline brings both functional ease and aesthetic sophistication to any dining or workspace environment.

title: BARBICAN
text_en: The Barbican chair by Rodolfo Dordoni embodies refined versatility, designed to complement a wide range of interiors with timeless elegance. The chair's thoughtfully proportioned silhouette balances comfort and sculptural shape, offering both open and armrest-equipped variations. Every line, curve, and surface has been considered to create a chair that is as visually engaging as it is inviting.

title: WOODY
text_en: Francesco Meda made his debut for Molteni&C with the Woody chair, a design that balances grace with simplicity. Its name evokes the warmth of its primary material, while its shape invites gatherings around a beautifully set table where conversation flows effortlessly.

title: GLOVE
text_en: The Glove chair by Patricia Urquiola transforms seating into a study of elegance and comfort, where a taut, lightly suspended metal structure meets strategic padding to create a fluid, enveloping form. Glove embodies a harmony of technology and tactile comfort, elevating the simple act of sitting into an experience of contemporary refinement.

The 1 2 3 chair by Michael Anastassiades embodies a harmonious blend of sophistication and comfort, emphasizing the purity of materials. Its name whimsically reflects the process of finding the ideal balance in the number of vertical slats adorning the backrest. After thoughtful consideration and testing, three slats were chosen, resulting in a structure that exudes elegance and lightness, embodying a refined synthesis of design principles.

title: D.235.1
text_en: The D.235.1 chair by Gio Ponti was originally designed between 1935 and 1938 for the first Montecatini Building in Milan. This exclusive re-edition is produced in polished aluminum based on the original drawings from the Gio Ponti Archives.

title: TEA
text_en: The Tea chair by Jasper Morrison is a tribute to lightness combined with effortless grace. Celebrating the beauty of simplicity, Tea reveals every curve and junction with clarity. Its name calls to mind a sense of ritual and refined living that resonate in its balanced proportions.

title: MOLLIS
