text_en: The Mollis stool by Vincent Van Duysen is a swivel design that combines comfort, stability, and elegant movement. Crafted to complement kitchen desks and adaptable to both residential and hospitality settings, it is defined by a compact footprint and carefully balanced proportions.

title: WOODY
text_en: The Woody stool by Francesco Meda, extends the design language of the Woody seating collection into a refined stool. Its name nods to both continuity and evolution — a piece that builds upon the collection’s simplicity while introducing new proportions suited for elevated seating. With its smooth lines and natural warmth, the stool invites moments of ease, whether gathered around a kitchen island or a lively bar.

title: DEVON
text_en: Rodolfo Dordoni's Devon collection extends to the bar stool: two versions, with or without backrest, bring the ease and elegance of the Devon chairs to counters, kitchen islands, and informal dining, completing the family alongside its four chairs and two bucket armchairs.

title: D.655.1 D.655.2
text_en: The D.655.1 D.655.2 drawer unit by Gio Ponti exemplifies the architect’s mastery of refined form and material harmony. Reinterpreted from original archival drawings created between 1952 and 1955 and realized under the art direction of Studio Cerri & Associati, this piece celebrates craftsmanship through its delicate interplay of hand-painted white drawer fronts and rich wood accents.

title: ANDROMEDA
text_en: A testament to refined craftsmanship and material innovation, the Andromeda sideboard emerges from the collaboration between UniFor and LSM, enriching the Molteni&C collection with a statement of elegance and precision. Conceived within the evocative setting of the Andromeda Theater in Sicily, this piece embodies the synthesis of aesthetic purity and cutting-edge construction.

title: MHC.1
text_en: MHC.1 celebrates Molteni&C’s pioneering spirit, reinterpreting the prototype of the company’s first modern furniture piece: Werner Blaser’s iconic chest of drawers. This re-edition honors the original’s innovative approach, where subtle details and precise craftsmanship converge. MHC.1 is a testament to the dialogue between mid-century modern vision and contemporary Italian living, bringing historical sophistication into today’s interiors.

title: CARTEGGIO
text_en: The Carteggio single unit by Aldo Rossi is defined by its tall, ordered structure embodying the designer’s fascination with memory, ritual, and the poetry of daily gestures. An elegant addition to the office or living space, this unique piece in solid wood is crafted for practical function in everyday living.

title: PIROSCAFO
text_en: Originally designed in 1994, the Piroscafo single unit by Aldo Rossi is a classic piece that has evolved with the times without betraying its origins as a rigorous but functional piece of furniture for versatile use in an array of interior spaces.

title: MHC.2
text_en: MHC.2 is a refined re-edition of Yasuhiko Itoh’s visionary bookcase, first conceived as a prototype in 1959. Crafted in curved wood, its elegant silhouette exemplifies the meticulous attention to form and proportion that defined mid-century modern design. Originally recognized with a Selettiva competition award, MHC.2 balances sculptural grace with functional utility, offering a timeless presence that enhances both contemporary and classic interiors.

title: TOUCH DOWN UNIT
text_en: The Touch Down Unit by Studio Klass reimagines the concept of the personal workstation for contemporary living. Originally designed for advanced professional environments, it has been adapted for the home with finishes that convey warmth and discretion. Touch Down transforms the act of working into a refined, organized experience, offering a compact, elegant space where daily tasks and personal items coexist.

title: MIDDAY
text_en: The Midday sideboard by GamFratesi is crafted with a clear, grounded construction. The design's form is reduced to a few essential elements: a central body supported by two legs, joined through a connection that reads as structural rather than decorative. Its proportions are calm and deliberate, giving the piece a stable silhouette suited to everyday use.

title: THEO
text_en: Designed by the visionary duo Yabu Pushelberg, the Theo bed is a celebration of comfort, warmth, and enveloping design. With its soft, rounded forms and generous proportions, Theo offers an immersive relaxation experience — an invitation to unwind in an embrace of effortless elegance.

title: TIBEAU
text_en: The Tibeau bed by GamFratesi is a striking celebration of solid wood, bringing bold architectural lines together with the refined craftsmanship that defines Molteni&C. With a commanding presence, its design draws from historical influences, embracing both strength and sophistication.

title: RIBBON
text_en: The Ribbon bed by Vincent Van Duysen is a textile design with a soft, enveloping silhouette that takes inspiration from the gentle curves of a ribbon, wrapping the structure in a continuous embrace. As his debut collaboration with Molteni&C, the Ribbon bed showcases Van Duysen’s refined approach to modern design, where natural materials and meticulous craftsmanship converge to create an object that feels both intimate and sculptural.

title: OVIDIO
text_en: The Ovidio bed by Vincent Van Duysen is designed to be the centerpiece of the bedroom: an extraordinary combination of sober elegance and utmost comfort, where no detail is left to chance and the leading role is played by the headboard.

title: ALDGATE
text_en: The Aldgate bed by Rodolfo Dordoni transforms the bedroom into a sanctuary of calm and understated elegance. Conceived as a self-contained island of rest, it blends contemporary sophistication with a subtle, welcoming presence. Every line and curve is thoughtfully considered, creating a bed that feels both refined and approachable.

title: FULHAM
text_en: The Fulham bed, named after the vibrant street at the heart of London, reflects Rodolfo Dordoni’s vision of understated elegance and practical refinement. This bed design's inviting proportions and carefully considered details create a space designed for relaxation, reflection, and restorative sleep.

title: HONEY
text_en: A timeless design by Arik Levy, the Honey bed seamlessly blends modern appeal with refined craftsmanship. Fully upholstered in plush fabric or supple leather, Honey’s tailored contours evoke the precision of the finest couturiers, offering a sophisticated focal point for intimate and versatile bedroom settings.

title: AZUL
text_en: The Azul bed by Nicola Gallizia balances tradition with modernity, bringing a sense of discreet sophistication to the bedroom. With its name evoking depth and serenity, Azul transforms the most private space in the home into an environment of elegance and comfort.

title: WISH
text_en: The Wish bed by Rodolfo Dordoni creates timeless elegance through a refined combination of wood, texture, and detail. Wish celebrates the natural warmth of solid timber and transforms the bedroom into a sanctuary of calm and comfort. Its understated lines and careful proportions inspire relaxation while highlighting a discerning commitment to craftsmanship and enduring design.

title: HIGH-WAVE
text_en: The High-Wave bed by Hannes Wettstein offers a refined balance of classic elegance and ergonomics, creating a thoughtful design built for rest. Its clean, sculptural curves and softly padded headboard, accented with a subtle vertical cord, invite a sense of sophistication combined with deep comfort.

title: REGIS
text_en: The Regis bench by Vincent Van Duysen balances practicality and versatility with seamless design. Whether used as additional seating or as a footrest, this elegant bench effortlessly transforms into a pouf. Regis adds a touch of elegance to any space, creating a warm and inviting environment in the bedroom or living space.

The 4040 drawer unit by Dante Bonuccelli is defined by generous proportions, crafted from refined eucalyptus wood. This piece complements the wide range of Molteni&C bedroom furniture while offering subtle sophistication through its natural materials and thoughtful detailing.

title: TIBEAU
text_en: The Tibeau bedside table by GamFratesi is defined by a strong, compact form and a clear material focus. Wood is the central element of the design, shaping both the structure and the visual identity of the piece and reflecting Molteni&C’s tradition of craftsmanship and material knowledge. Every element is resolved through carving, thickness, and proportion rather than applied detail.

title: CORTECCIA
text_en: The Corteccia rug by Marta Ferri balances surface depth and material variation in a tactile interpretation of natural textures. Its design is inspired by the bark of ancient trees, with a striking three-dimensional texture comprising irregular reliefs with varied yarn heights for a tactile finish that changes under light and movement.

title: SWAY
text_en: A visionary design for outdoor seating, Sway is a modular sofa system by the renowned Yabu Pushelberg. Drawing inspiration from a deep love for nature and an expert command of design, the Sway sofa redefines outdoor spaces with its versatility and fluid forms.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: Balancing architectural precision with elegant ease, the Soleva 2–3‑seater sofa by Vincent Van Duysen embodies a refined vision of outdoor living. Guided by the gentle rhythm of sunlight — the inspiration behind its name — the Soleva sofa balances lightness and structural presence. Defined by a continuous, slender tubular frame, the design's clear, linear profiles soften into fluid contours, creating a visual harmony that blends in naturally with any outdoor setting.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: A refined evolution of the original indoor concept, the Chelsea Modular Outdoor sofa reinterprets its distinctive identity for open‑air living while preserving the collection’s formal coherence. Developed by Studio Dordoni, the outdoor version translates the architectural clarity of the indoor system into a structure engineered for durability, comfort, and visual elegance.

title: PHOENIX
text_en: Rooted in Mediterranean tradition and defined by modern restraint, the Phoenix Sofa by Vincent Van Duysen translates artisanal techniques into a contemporary language of design. The union of fer forgé and hand-woven polypropylene rope celebrates the tactile richness of craft, while the clean, minimal lines convey effortless elegance.

title: BOBOLI
text_en: Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Boboli sofa by Vincent Van Duysen showcases a solid teak wood frame and seat, perfectly capturing the fusion of nature and design embodied by Molteni&C Outdoor Collection. The backrest, woven by hand using polypropylene fiber ribbons in ecru employs superior craftsmanship to create a natural effect.

title: PALINFRASCA
text_en: The Palinfrasca Sofa by Vincent Van Duysen embodies a dialogue between heritage and innovation, drawing inspiration from Luca Meda’s original 1994 design. Its instantly recognizable silhouette channels the warmth and elegance of teak while expressing Molteni&C’s mastery of materials and craftsmanship. This sofa embodies a contemporary interpretation of tradition, reflecting decades of expertise and a commitment to refined living that transforms any outdoor space into a sanctuary of comfort and style.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: Embodying clarity in its sculpted silhouette, the Soleva armchair by Vincent Van Duysen brings a grounded feel to outdoor environments. Its continuous tubular aluminum frame traces a precise outline, softened by gentle curves that create a welcoming, enveloping shape. This armchair distills the essence of the Soleva family into one key outdoor element, inviting moments of pause and reflection for unhurried moments surrounded by nature.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: The Chelsea Outdoor armchair by Studio Dordoni distills the character of Rodolfo Dordoni's original indoor design into a compact and expressive form, uniting craftsmanship, comfort, and architectural clarity. Its powder‑coated aluminum base defines a lightweight yet robust structure designed to withstand outdoor conditions without sacrificing elegance. The distinctive geometry of the frame highlights the armchair’s balanced proportions, giving it a presence that feels both understated and confident.

title: D.154.2
text_en: Gio Ponti’s D.154.2 armchair, a masterpiece originally conceived for Villa Planchart in Caracas (1953-1957), is reborn in an elegant outdoor edition. This reinterpretation honors the timeless design with meticulous attention to materials and technical refinement, ensuring lasting beauty and resilience.

title: BOBOLI
text_en: A Vincent Van Duysen original, the Boboli armchair is an iconic and innovative creation characterized by its light and airy lines, seamlessly blending with the outdoor environment.

title: PETALO
text_en: With the Petalo armchair, Vincent Van Duysen enhances the Outdoor Collection with gentle curves and delicately enveloping seating. A testament to the artistry inherent in the collection, these designs reimagine outdoor atmospheres thanks to their inviting aesthetic.

title: PHOENIX
text_en: The Phoenix armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is designed to meet the evolving needs of contemporary outdoor living, combining refined geometry with a human-centered understanding of ergonomics. Each piece balances presence and lightness, offering a versatile seating experience that harmonizes effortlessly with the surrounding nature outdoors.

title: D.150.5
text_en: D.150.5 chaise longue, reintroduced in collaboration with the Gio Ponti Archives, is one of the few outdoor furnishings conceived by Ponti. Originally designed in 1952 for the legendary cruise ship Andrea Doria, this piece embodies Ponti’s vision of fluid spaces and furniture that adapts to life’s ever-changing moments, merging nautical elegance with the comfort of outdoor living.

title: LOUISA
text_en: The Louisa Outdoor coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen carry the same dialogue between material and form as their indoor counterparts, reinterpreted for life in the open air. Crafted from weather-resistant wood and reinforced cement, the collection preserves Van Duysen's signature refined contrasts in a design built to endure the elements — offering a sculptural contemporary centerpiece for elegant terraces, courtyards, and garden settings.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: The Chelsea Outdoor small table by Studio Dordoni enriches the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection with an element designed to support and complete open‑air living spaces. Its distinctive powder‑coated aluminum base reflects a commitment to materials that are lightweight, resilient, and high‑performing in outdoor environments. With its clean geometry and timeless finish, the table integrates naturally into a wide variety of outdoor settings.

title: SWAY
text_en: A visionary design for outdoor seating, Sway is a modular sofa system by the renowned Yabu Pushelberg. Drawing inspiration from a deep love for nature and an expert command of design, the Sway sofa redefines outdoor spaces with its versatility and fluid forms.

title: PHOENIX
text_en: Completing the Timeout Collection, the Phoenix outdoor coffee table by Vincent Van Duysen extends the collection’s signature aesthetic. Available in two widths, it offers a versatile presence, from intimate gatherings to convivial entertaining. Its design reflects the same considered geometry and refined motifs found throughout the Timeout range.

title: REGENT
text_en: The Regent coffee table designed by Vincent Van Duysen is a collection of coffee tables with three distinct top shapes — round, oval, and square — each conceived as both a sculptural object and a practical surface. Their proportions are carefully calibrated to create a harmonious visual dialogue, allowing the pieces to nest effortlessly and transform living spaces into layered compositions.

title: PANNA COTTA
text_en: The Panna Cotta outdoor coffee table by Ron Gilad captures a distinctive paradox between delicate form and stability. This table is a study in contrast: light in appearance yet grounded in material strength, making it a sculptural yet practical addition to outdoor living spaces.

title: PANTALICA
text_en: Blending a natural aesthetic with circular materials that preserve their character over time, the Pantalica coffee table by Elisa Ossino is a sculptural centerpiece for the outdoor living area. Inspired by Mediterranean landscapes and the cultures that inhabited them in antiquity, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

title: PICEA
text_en: The Picea coffee table, a Vincent Van Duysen design, is a seamless addition to the Outdoor Timeout Collection. Crafted entirely in ceramic, Picea boasts gracefully rounded lines and a harmonious design, echoing the natural beauty of the Arctic evergreen spruce tree from which it takes its name.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: As a central gathering point for lounging in the open air, the Soleva table by Vincent Van Duysen embodies the dialogue between solidity and visual lightness that defines the Soleva collection. Its elongated, architectural frame in powder‑coated tubular aluminum establishes a clean, measured structure that anchors outdoor spaces. Fully stackable, the design brings thoughtful functionality to both residential terraces and tranquil hospitality environments.

title: GOLDEN GATE
text_en: The Timeout Collection's Golden Gate dining table by Vincent Van Duysen reinterprets the traditional outdoor table with a refined sense of proportion and material sophistication. Designed to seat six or eight, it combines functionality with elegance, offering a surface that is both practical for daily use and harmonious within contemporary outdoor settings.

title: ARC OUTDOOR
text_en: The Arc table by Foster + Partners brings architectural poetry to the outdoors in a sculptural expression of strength and lightness. Inspired by the advanced techno-structures of contemporary architecture, Arc translates engineering precision into refined design. Its bold silhouette transforms outdoor spaces with a sense of modern elegance.

title: FAIRMOUNT
text_en: Vincent Van Duysen brings his visionary touch to the outdoors with the Fairmount table, a meticulously crafted piece that embraces natural settings with elegance. Crafted from exquisite solid teak, the Fairmount table highlights Molteni&C expertise in woodwork, merging the luxurious essence of teak with the emotional language of the Landmark Collection.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: With its measured proportions and timeless elegance, the Soleva chair by Vincent Van Duysen translates the architectural clarity of the Soleva family in an upright posture, offering the support and composure needed for shared meals, long conversations, and leisurely gatherings in the open air. Its powder‑coated tubular aluminum structure outlines a light yet sturdy profile that integrates seamlessly into diverse outdoor settings.

title: CHELSEA
text_en: The Chelsea Outdoor chair by Studio Dordoni distills the identity of the original Rodolfo Dordoni design for enjoyment in the open air. Its distinctive powder‑coated aluminum base defines a lightweight yet resilient structure that stands up to outdoor conditions while maintaining a sleek, contemporary profile. The chair’s balanced proportions and subtle geometry convey an understated elegance that harmonizes effortlessly with a variety of outdoor settings.

title: CLUB
text_en: The Club folding chair by Yabu Pushelberg introduces a new gesture within the Molteni&C Outdoor collection — an object that moves lightly through space, designed to follow the shifting rhythm of outdoor life. Conceived with the poetic spirit of nomadic furnishings, it embodies the freedom of seating that appears where it is needed most: a sunlit terrace at midday, the shaded edge of a garden in the late afternoon, or any place where the environment inspires a moment of pause.

title: COBEA
text_en: The Cobea chair by Vincent Van Duysen is a celebration of timeless design and meticulous artistry. An embodiment of the designer’s strong vision for outdoors, the chair pays homage to nature and natural elements, interpreting the beauty of solid teak wood in a contemporary manner.

title: GREEN POINT
text_en: The Greenpoint chair by Vincent Van Duysen embodies the natural dialogue between structure and softness. Its burnished aluminum frame traces a fluid, continuous line, evoking a distinctly modern sensibility. This clean geometry is balanced by a handwoven polypropylene rope seat and backrest, a traditional craft detail that introduces texture, depth, and a sense of refinement.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: Compact yet expressive, the Soleva stool translates the collection’s architectural language into a refined, vertical silhouette. The powder‑coated tubular aluminum structure defines a slender, upright profile that remains light in appearance while offering reassuring stability.

title: GREEN POINT
text_en: Compact in its seating dimensions, the Green Point stool features a slender structure characterized by a flat band frame in burnished painted aluminum with rounded edges. Seen in profile, the slender thickness of the band gives the stool a delicate, airy silhouette, contrasting with the dense, textured upholstery in the traditional weave pattern that characterizes the entire Timeout Collection.

title: PANTALICA
text_en: Designed to serve as seating or to be used as small tables, the Pantalica stools by Elisa Ossino offer a compelling accent to outdoor living areas. Their minimalistic shapes are inspired by archaic forms drawn from the ancient cultures of the Mediterranean basin, creating an aesthetic that evokes a rustic and timeless feel. Named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily, the Pantalica collection interprets influences from antiquity for contemporary outdoor spaces.

title: SOLEVA
text_en: Carrying the warmth of its name, the Soleva sunbed by Vincent Van Duysen translates the collection’s architectural sensibility into a design dedicated to rest, light, and the open sky. Its slender, powder‑coated aluminum frame traces a precise, elongated silhouette — light to the eye yet robust in structure.

title: GUELL
text_en: The Guell sunbed by Vincent Van Duysen reimagines the essence of outdoor relaxation with a design that is both elegant and versatile. Rooted in the Timeout Collection’s distinctive aesthetic, it harmonizes the burnished painted aluminum band with the tactile warmth of handwoven polypropylene rope. The sunbed combines thoughtful detailing and refined materials to create a setting of comfortable leisure.

title: PANTALICA
text_en: Balancing sinuous curves with elegant linearity, the Pantalica daybed by Elisa Ossino brings a sculptural form to outdoor lounge areas. Rooted in rustic Mediterranean inspiration, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

title: HELIOS
text_en: The Helios outdoor kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen blends refined design with advanced functionality for contemporary outdoor living. With its clean, disciplined lines and monolithic presence, Helios complements Molteni&C’s Landmark and Timeout collections, creating a harmonious ensemble of outdoor furnishings. Its understated elegance and versatile aesthetic make it a focal point for terraces and gardens, where practicality meets the quiet sophistication of modern Italian design.

title: HYDE
text_en: A study in comfort and subtle craftsmanship, the Hyde pouf by Vincent Van Duysen completes the ensemble of outdoor accessories with elegance and practicality. Available in two sizes, it is designed to harmonize with the Outdoor Collection furniture with its woven texture and thoughtful proportions that provide a versatile element for outdoor compositions.

title: FRONDA
text_en: Balancing refined technical precision with a discreet elegance, the Fronda parasol enriches outdoor spaces with a design that is both architectural and understated. Fronda translates high-performance engineering into a pure, elemental form.

title: BOULOGNE
text_en: Light, versatile, and elegantly crafted, the Boulogne outdoor baskets bring order and refinement to terraces, gardens, and poolside settings. Inspired by the woven textures of Molteni&C’s outdoor collections, the design celebrates the simple rhythm of warp and weft, harmonizing with the Hyde pouf to create a cohesive, sculptural dialogue in outdoor spaces.

title: UENO
text_en: The Ueno screen by Vincent Van Duysen extends the Timeout collection with a refined balance of structure and texture, designed to define and enrich outdoor spaces. Its presence offers subtle spatial modulation while reflecting a contemporary Italian aesthetic. Ueno transforms boundaries into expressions of elegance, infusing any terrace or garden with warmth and understated sophistication.

title: MASTER DRESSING
text_en: Master Dressing, designed by Vincent Van Duysen, elevates the concept of the walk-in wardrobe into a realm of architectural elegance and refined functionality. Conceived to complement the Gliss Master wardrobes, it transforms storage into a harmonious experience, where form and utility converge. Every element is crafted to create a cohesive aesthetic, offering a sophisticated solution for the modern bedroom.
